fix: On Unix, each decision checks both lexical and resolved filesystem scope for Grant allow/deny facts; unresolved links fail closed. File resources containing both a symlink component and .. are rejected before normalization.
validation: ruff check and py_compile for changed native drivers
limitations: This is decision-time canonicalization, not an atomic host file open. A same-UID symlink swap after decision remains possible.
A different container mount namespace may resolve paths differently from the local daemon.
Windows retains its lexical path implementation pending a native path-identity contract and real-host validation; macOS was cross-built but not real-host tested.
Stock OpenClaw lacks a post-approval execution checkpoint. This evidence does not close hold execution or cross-process external-effect atomicity.
